# AGENTS.md — arduino-rfid-scanner

<!-- Generated by mis-workspace ONBOARDING.md from the repo profile. This is now the repo's own contract, so maintain it here. -->

## Purpose

Firmware for an Arduino UNO R4 WiFi with an MFRC522 RFID reader. It reads a card, formats the UID as uppercase hex bytes joined by `:` (e.g. `04:A3:1F:2B`), and POSTs it over Wi-Fi to the mis-backend Laravel API. A push button toggles the yellow LED, which selects one of two modes:

| Yellow LED | Mode | Request |
|---|---|---|
| ON | **Attendance** (time-in on first scan of the day, time-out after) | `POST /api/scan`, `Content-Type: application/json`, body `{"rfid":"<UID>"}` |
| OFF (boot default) | **Card-assignment relay** (UID forwarded to an admin's browser, only while the admin window is open) | `POST /api/rfid/scan`, `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, body `rfid=<UID>` |

Hardware and pin map (`mis/mis.ino`, `README.md`):

| Component | Pin |
|---|---|
| MFRC522 SS / RST | D10 / D7 (SPI on the hardware SPI header) |
| Red LED (Wi-Fi down) | D6 |
| Green LED (Wi-Fi up) | D5 |
| Yellow LED (mode) | D3 |
| Button (to GND, `INPUT_PULLUP`, active LOW) | D4 |

## Ownership

Owner: a.baladon@qstrike.com. Part of the `mis` project — shared plans, rules and wiki live in the workspace and are linked here at `.claude/common/` and `.claude/diagrams/`.

## Local Contracts

- Stack: C++ / Arduino (UNO R4 WiFi, Renesas core; libraries MFRC522, WiFiS3, SPI) — no pinned version · DB: none (the device stores nothing; mis-backend owns all data)
- Layer chain (build order): config → hardware-setup → connectivity → input-handling → api-client → main-loop. Layers are sections of the single sketch `mis/mis.ino`; the sketch must stay in its same-named folder.
- Coding rules: `.claude/rules/rules-common.md`, `.claude/rules/rules-firmware.md`. Both are binding.
- Implementation agent: `rfid-developer`. Auditor: `rfid-auditor`.
- Plans for this repo: `.claude/common/plans/active/<slug>/plan-rfid.md`
- **Frozen contract**: the two endpoints, their content types, the `rfid` field name and the UID format do not change unless mis-backend changes in the same ticket. The encodings are deliberately not unified. No auth header, no `Accept` header (the backend forces JSON). Every request has a 5 s bounded wait and always calls `client.stop()`.
- **Secrets**: Wi-Fi SSID/password and server host/port live in gitignored `mis/arduino_secrets.h`; `mis/arduino_secrets.h.example` lists every key with placeholders. Never put secrets or IPs in `mis.ino`, never log them.
- **SMS is being removed**: SIM900A / SoftwareSerial / `sendSMS()` code is retired; parent notification becomes a backend push to mis-mobile. Do not add on-device notification code.
- **Logging**: all Serial output goes through `LOG_*` macros that compile to nothing when `DEBUG_SERIAL` is `0`. No bare `Serial.print*`; no logging inside inner byte/wait loops.

## Work Guidance

- Run: no CLI — open `mis/mis.ino` in the Arduino IDE, board "Arduino UNO R4 WiFi", Upload, then Serial Monitor @ 9600 · Test: none (manual on hardware) · Lint: none
- Optional CLI build if `arduino-cli` is installed: `arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:renesas_uno:unor4wifi mis`
- Ports: none of its own; calls mis-backend on port 8000 (plain HTTP on the LAN)
- New hardware/feature: constants in config, init in `setup()`, logic in a named function called from `loop()` (pattern: `checkWiFi()`). Update the README wiring table when pins change.
- `loop()` order: `checkWiFi()` → button edge → card read (early return if none) → mode branch → `rfid.PICC_HaltA()`.

## Verification

- Manual (no automated tests): Arduino IDE **Verify** for UNO R4 WiFi passes with `DEBUG_SERIAL` 1 and 0; **Upload**; with Serial Monitor @ 9600 open, scan a card in **both** modes (yellow ON → `/api/scan`, yellow OFF → `/api/rfid/scan`) and check the logged status lines and LED states (red/green Wi-Fi, yellow mode). Record what was checked in the PR/commit.
- `rfid-auditor` passes on staged changes before commit

# DOX framework

AGENTS.md files are binding work contracts for their subtrees. Before editing, read this file plus every AGENTS.md on the path to each file you'll touch; the nearest one is the local contract. After a meaningful change, update the closest owning AGENTS.md if purpose, structure, contracts, routes, entities, or workflows changed, and remove stale text. Create a child AGENTS.md when a folder becomes a durable boundary. Child sections: Purpose · Ownership · Local Contracts · Work Guidance · Verification · Child DOX Index.
